raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Change ModelRunnerOutput.num_nans_in_logits to be an np.ndarray instead of a python dict for host side speedup. Additionally, found a bug where num_nans_in_logits is calculated incorrectly when speculative decoding is turned on in both Model Runner V1 and Model Runner V2.

## Purpose
Part of 'Data structure clean up' roadmap item in [#32455](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/32455).

## Test Plan
Tested on cpu only, so only old model runner v1 is hit.

## Test Result
LLM.generate showed 3.3% improvement with VLLM_COMPUTE_NANS_IN_LOGITS turned on.

---

<summary> Essential Elements of an Effective PR Description Checklist </summary>

- [ ] The purpose of the PR, such as "Fix some issue (link existing issues this PR will resolve)".
- [ ] The test plan, such as providing test command.

</details>

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the tracking of NaN values in logits by replacing dictionary-based storage with `np.ndarray` across the scheduler, model runner, and output classes to improve performance. A logic error was identified in `_get_nans_in_logits` where NaNs are undercounted during speculative decoding because the implementation only accounts for a single token per request instead of summing across all tokens. The reviewer suggested using `spec_decode_metadata` to correctly aggregate these counts.

+@triton.jit
+def _num_nans_spec_decode_kernel(
+    logits_ptr,
+    logits_stride,
+    cu_num_logits_ptr,
+    num_nans_ptr,
+    vocab_size,
+    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req_idx = tl.program_id(0)
+    start_idx = tl.load(cu_num_logits_ptr + req_idx)
+    end_idx = tl.load(cu_num_logits_ptr + req_idx + 1)
+    num_logits = end_idx - start_idx
+
+    num_nans = 0
+    for row_offset in range(num_logits):
+        row_idx = start_idx + row_offset
+        for i in range(0, vocab_size, BLOCK_SIZE):
+            block = i + tl.arange(0, BLOCK_SIZE)
+            mask = block < vocab_size
+            logits = tl.load(
+                logits_ptr + row_idx * logits_stride + block,
+                mask=mask,
+                other=0,
+            )
+            logits = logits.to(tl.float32)
+            is_nan = libdevice.isnan(logits).to(tl.int1)
+            num_nans += tl.sum(is_nan).to(tl.int32)
+    tl.store(num_nans_ptr + req_idx, num_nans)
+

+def get_num_nans_spec_decode(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    cu_num_logits: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    num_reqs = cu_num_logits.shape[0] - 1
+    vocab_size = logits.shape[1]
+    BLOCK_SIZE = 8192
+    num_nans = torch.empty(num_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=logits.device)
+    _num_nans_spec_decode_kernel[(num_reqs,)](
+        logits,
+        logits.stride(0),
+        cu_num_logits,
+        num_nans,
+        vocab_size,
+        BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
+    )
+    return num_nans
